A '''battle''' was fought on the<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Voon system/Legends|Voon system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voon/Legends|Voon]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before<ref name="TotJC" /> [[4050 BBY]].<ref name="4000 date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' establishes that the first battle on [[Voon/Legends|Voon]] was fought "[[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]" prior to [[Arca Jeth]] becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' both establish that Jeth had attained that rank by the [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Gender/Legends|he]] participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|victory]] over the [[Lorell Raiders]]. Since ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' dates the defeat of the Lorell Raiders to approximately [[4050 BBY]], the first battle on Voon must have been fought decades prior to that date.</ref>
